<div class="review-text">
Essential support for VRChat, particularly concerning the convincing use of furniture and furniture-related props.<br>
<br>
Not worth $8.00 though, it was fine when it was free. Find an alternative to buying this.<br>
<br>
What's worse, it plays poorly with newer versions of SteamVR and mangles the chaperone in all sorts of clever (read: dreadful) ways. Find something properly maintained.
